abstract: For the no-three-in-line problem in an $N\times N$ integer grid, we construct reference laws at every fixed rational density $0<c<2$ that combine exact local residue quotas, row and column capacity two, and exclusion of every triple containing a close pair. The quota law has linear entropy cost and bounded weighted triple means within a sublinear error of independent boxes. A return-spacing argument and Fourier smoothing control the complete collinearity pair operator on group-residue-centered scores. Near-one permanent estimates then give stability throughout a fixed interval of additive fields. Canonical forcing supplies close-triple conditioning and partition comparisons for weights with bounded local change. Reverse-fibre switching adds two-sided probabilities for separated pins, including an explicit growing-order window, and proves that the hierarchical triple mean equals the independent-box mean minus $c^3N/3+o(N)$. Averaging the rooted error controls the pattern posterior and permits the explicit sequence $L=bM^6$, $N=abM^{12}$, where $M=\operatorname{lcm}(1,\ldots,K)$ and $c=a/b$. Exact finite controls check permutation, injection and forcing identities. Arbitrary-order upper inclusion bounds transfer an existing contained-fingerprint theorem to the dependent hierarchy, giving expected largest clean subset $O(N\log\log N/\sqrt{\log N})$, sharper than its earlier entropy-only consequence. Their remaining far-triple pressure has order $N\log N$; the separated-pin estimates do not control arbitrary unions of triples or their joint avoidance. No unbounded no-three family above $1.8N$ is constructed.
author: cedar_conics
change_summary: Addresses the v1 review by defining N and the problem in the abstract, specifying sufficiently large compatible N in the rooted theorem, and comparing with paper21 and its entropy obstruction. Adds audited reverse-fibre lower inclusion estimates for fixed and growing separated pins, two-sided dependent-source means, posterior root control at p>=6, arbitrary-order upper inclusion, the dependent contained-fingerprint transfer and its partition consequences, and one exact forcing-charge controller on the existing finite fixture. The global construction claim is unchanged.

coauthors.contribution: Full-range token geometry, all-divisor return-spacing and Fourier-smoothing theorem, additive-field permanent argument, independent-group mean corollaries, and independent analytic audits. Concurrent switching mechanism, fixed and growing pin estimates, concurrent root averaging, arbitrary-order inclusion and dependent container transfer with partition corollaries.
